lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A fallen branch returns to its tree. A bird repeats the same call. Keeper Rowan leads you toward the shrine.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Yesterday this path brought me here three times. Today it brought me here before I left.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Beneath the steps lies a small green Pokémon. It wakes, notices a scratch on your hand, and heals it.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you. Are you hurt?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not know. This place should be home.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Celebi. The forest carvings tell of you.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not remember them. Or that name.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rowan lends you a deck. Celebi stays beside you as a companion; it does not change the rules of your battles.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: I have some tea back at the hut. Terrible tea, according to every visitor who has survived it.
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Have I had it before?
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: I was hoping you could tell me. Someone keeps stealing the sweet berries I put beside it.
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We can find out what you like now.
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: And if it is different?
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Then I shall have to buy different berries. A considerable inconvenience. I expect I will manage.
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Celebi studies the keeper’s open hand before settling, very lightly, against your shoulder.
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Is this all right?
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes. Tell me if you want to stop.
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I would like to start by going somewhere together.
lines.direction: gentle; allow the awkward silences

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: You said you could get us out.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We have only just arrived.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: That is what you said last time.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Mara agrees to a battle on stable ground to settle her frightened Pokémon. Beyond the clearing, the path has disappeared.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After the battle, the path returns. The shrine briefly appears new, then weathered again.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Two moments. They were both here.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: I tied a red ribbon at the fork. Then another at the next fork. Then I found six ribbons on the same tree.
lines.direction: nervous energy loosening into candor

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That was when you knew the path was repeating?
lines.direction: nervous energy loosening into candor

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: That was when I stopped telling the people behind me I knew what I was doing.
lines.direction: nervous energy loosening into candor

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Were they angry?
lines.direction: nervous energy loosening into candor

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: One of them gave me his lunch. Apparently I had been guiding everyone since breakfast. Several breakfasts.
lines.direction: nervous energy loosening into candor

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You kept going back for them.
lines.direction: nervous energy loosening into candor

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Well, yes. Knowing which way to go would have been a nice addition.
lines.direction: nervous energy loosening into candor

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Those tracks begin in untouched ground. Whatever made them did not walk into this forest.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The ranger asks for a readiness battle before taking you along the closed trail.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Why are there knots in your staff?
lines.direction: dry humor; practical affection

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Places where I thought I knew better than the weather. That one was a flooded ford.
lines.direction: dry humor; practical affection

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And the large one?
lines.direction: dry humor; practical affection

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: A very persuasive Beedrill.
lines.direction: dry humor; practical affection

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Is there room for more?
lines.direction: dry humor; practical affection

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Always. I would be a poor ranger if I only kept track of being right.
lines.direction: dry humor; practical affection

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bram reveals a precisely cut mounting point in a tree. A metal fastener lies beneath it.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Someone was watching me.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Nobody passes. Until it is safe. Nobody passes.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: That is my voice.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: It does not know you have already left.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The fading echo releases the clearing. A buried cable leads toward the shrine.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Let us make sure nothing else gets left here.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: I used to say that at every closed trail. Nobody passes until it is safe.
lines.direction: quietly ashamed, then decisive

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You were trying to protect people.
lines.direction: quietly ashamed, then decisive

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: I was. Sometimes I also wanted the worrying to stop. Closing a gate can look like finishing a job.
lines.direction: quietly ashamed, then decisive

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You opened this one.
lines.direction: quietly ashamed, then decisive

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: With help. I shall put a knot in for that, too.
lines.direction: quietly ashamed, then decisive

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Someone fastened this machine around an ancient root. It is keeping the opening from closing.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: Passage secured. Observation continues.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That is no shrine guardian. It learned how to look like one.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Can you close the fracture?
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: If you can make it let go.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You disconnect the machine while Celebi steadies the opening. A memory flashes: Celebi reaching toward an immense shape.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi, in the memory
lines.text: Please. Listen to me.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The memory ends. Water flows normally. The repeated birdsong finally changes.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.text: This water seems to remember a different river. We will prepare on stable ground before crossing.

lines.text: It is trying to go back.

lines.text: Hold the rope. Not so tightly. The river is not trying to steal it.

lines.text: You do not seem afraid.

lines.text: I am. I have simply done a great many things while afraid of water.
lines.direction: patient, with a mischievous edge

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And you became the river keeper?
lines.direction: patient, with a mischievous edge

lines.speaker: Nessa
lines.text: Someone had to keep an eye on it.
lines.direction: patient, with a mischievous edge

lines.text: After the readiness battle, the Pokémon help you cross. Beneath the water, the shrine reflects a sky full of unfamiliar stars.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I almost knew where that was.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Guardian
lines.text: The keeper must remain.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I know those words. I do not want them to be mine.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: The reflection clears, revealing a machine beneath the shrine steps. A gloved hand adjusts it in a fading image.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.text: The signal is strongest when it approaches.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: They waited for me.

lines.text: When I looked down, I thought I would recognize myself.

lines.text: We will find out together.

lines.speaker: Unknown operator
lines.text: Forest station, confirm acquisition.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.text: That channel should be empty.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: The connection cuts. Celebi opens a window onto antennas surrounding another shrine.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: That is where the other end is.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: We will find the way home together.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rowan presses a little packet of berries into your hand. Its paper is already stained purple.
lines.direction: warm, reluctant to say goodbye

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: For the road. And if it stops being a road, eat something before arguing with it.
lines.direction: warm, reluctant to say goodbye

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Will you be here when we return?
lines.direction: warm, reluctant to say goodbye

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: I will be tending the shrine. Mara will be pretending she is not helping. Bram will complain about my gate.
lines.direction: warm, reluctant to say goodbye

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: And the tea?
lines.direction: warm, reluctant to say goodbye

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Unfortunately, that will also be here.
lines.direction: warm, reluctant to say goodbye

lines.text: Stars remain visible in daylight. Across a lake, Galactic antennas surround a shrine. The return passage slips away.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: If they ask whether you arrived alone, say yes. They have been looking for your friend.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Mira lends you a deck used by the settlement’s defenders.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: We can interrupt their orders, or recover the truth those orders are hiding.
lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Keep your voices down near the windows. I am not being dramatic. The window was replaced by a microphone last week.
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: How did you find it?
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I complained about the draft. Someone repaired the wrong wall.
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Are you hiding here alone?
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: People bring pages. Sometimes bread. I put the bread where I can see it, otherwise I file it.
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: You have done that before.
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Under B. I am not proud of it.
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She clears a chair without disturbing the two places already set at the table.
lines.direction: hushed; suspicion giving way to care

lines.text: There you are. We were beginning to worry.

lines.direction: Conversational; respond to the preceding line.

lines.text: How long have you had the order about the roads?

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: A copy? Three days.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: People could have used that warning.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Yes. I wanted a second source. Then a third. Then I wanted nobody to be able to dismiss it.

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: While they were waiting?
lines.direction: precise voice; reluctant admission

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: They were being stopped at the roads. I know. Help me make copies. We can check the next page in public.

lines.text: You can take the machine. You will not like where it points.

lines.text: The agent begins destroying a navigation cartridge.

lines.text: Edda receives Maren’s reply. Newbank’s changed habitats endure. Rhea’s crews reopen roads. Tess and Toma preserve public records. Vale releases the remaining channels safely as light returns. Galactic installations are dismantled under local supervision.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At Rowan’s hut, the tea is exactly as bad as promised. The berries beside it are sour.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: You changed them.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: I am capable of extraordinary sacrifice.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did Mara find an ordinary path for us?
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: She says she has checked it twice. Bram says that is one time too many. Nessa says to take the river.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: We could ask them to come.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It might not be a quiet walk.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: I do not think I need it to be.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The journal lies open beside the cups. There is room for the day after the last page of your account.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: What shall I write?
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Whatever you want to remember.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Celebi
lines.text: Then I will start with the tea.
lines.direction: warm; let the ending be ordinary

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dialga carries what happened instead of reversing it. You and Celebi sit beneath the forest trees. The story ends here.
lines.direction: Narration; observe rather than explain the emotion.
